name: mendix-app-switcher
title: Mendix App Switcher
description: Browse Mendix Team Server apps and branches, open local checkouts, or start a remote checkout.
author: vlad

commands.name: switch
commands.title: Open Mendix Branch
commands.description: Pick an app and branch to open, or clone it if it is not local yet

commands.name: manage-apps
commands.title: Manage Mendix Apps
commands.description: Add and remove the Mendix projects shown in the switcher

commands.name: versions
commands.title: Mendix Studio Pro Versions
commands.description: List installed Studio Pro versions and launch one

preferences.name: cloneType
preferences.title: Default Clone Type
preferences.description: Full history uses a reusable local cache. Partial downloads historical file contents on demand and needs network access for some operations.

preferences.name: reuseLocalRepositories
preferences.title: Reuse Local Repositories
preferences.label: Use a repository cache for full checkouts
preferences.description: Seed from a compatible local checkout when possible; existing project files are never modified.

preferences.name: repositoryCacheRoot
preferences.title: Repository Cache Root (optional)
preferences.description: Defaults to .mendix-switcher-cache in the app's projects root. Prefer the same volume as checkouts for hard-link reuse.

preferences.name: detailedCloneDiagnostics
preferences.title: Detailed Clone Diagnostics
preferences.label: Record Git Trace2 performance data
preferences.description: Off by default. Logs can contain repository paths and branch names; review them before sharing.

preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: Mendix Personal Access Token
preferences.description: PAT with mx:modelrepository:repo:read. Sent only to repository.api.mendix.com as Authorization: MxToken.

preferences.name: projectsRoot
preferences.title: Local Projects Root
preferences.description: A parent folder containing your local Studio Pro checkouts; example C:\Mendix.

preferences.name: studioProExecutable
preferences.title: Studio Pro Executable (optional)
preferences.description: Opens local and freshly cloned MPRs with this studiopro.exe; also used for the assisted download.

preferences.name: jiraSiteUrl
preferences.title: Jira Site (optional)
preferences.description: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. yourcompany.atlassian.net. With email and API token set, branches named after an issue show its summary and status.

preferences.name: jiraEmail
preferences.title: Jira Email (optional)
preferences.description: The Atlassian account email that the API token belongs to.

preferences.name: jiraApiToken
preferences.title: Jira API Token (optional)
preferences.description: A classic API token from id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens. Sent only to the Jira site above.

preferences.name: jiraProjectKeys
preferences.title: Jira Project Keys (optional)
preferences.description: Comma-separated, e.g. OOMO. Limits issue detection to these projects and also matches lower-case branch names. Empty: any upper-case KEY-123.
